title: Ship Fast, Learn Faster: Live Mixpanel AI Session on Closing the Product Intelligence Gap – July 30
summary: Join Mixpanel's live session on July 30 to learn how Mixpanel AI bridges the product intelligence gap with live demos and Q&A.
body_markdown:
📣


Mixpanel is hosting a live session on July 30 — and it's one worth showing up for.


[Ship Fast, Learn Faster: Using Mixpanel AI to Close the Product Intelligence Gap](https://events.mixpanel.com/ship-fast-learn-faster-mixpanel-ai?utm_source=mixpanel-community&utm_medium=slack&utm_campaign=WBN-2026-07-30-ShipFastMixpanelAI-NA-FM&utm_content=WBN-2026-07-30-ShipFastMixpanelAI-NA-FM)


📅


July 30 | 11am PST / 2pm EST | 45 min + live Q&A The premise: AI has made building faster. It hasn't made understanding your users any easier. The gap between how fast teams ship and how quickly they can learn from it is widening — and it's the bottleneck most product teams face. In this session, Tyler Goerzen (Senior PM) and Emma Janiszewski (SE) go live to walk through how Mixpanel AI closes it — across all four components of the system:


-


Context Engine


— grounds AI in your actual business logic, not generic assumptions


-


Mixpanel Agent


— your always-on analyst for root cause, KPI monitoring, and dashboards


-


MCP


— brings product intelligence into Slack, Claude, Cursor, and wherever your team works


-


Mixpanel Headless


— embeds that intelligence into your own tools and workflows


Live demos. Live Q&A. If you've been curious about what "AI-native analytics" actually looks like in practice, this is the session.


🔗
